blocks.content: Quiz: Which table is the left table in the following SQL statement?

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.manager
FROM Employees e
JOIN Departments d
ON e.department = d.department_name;
Tap an option below to answer:
The Customers table is the left table.

Employees is the left table because it is the first table in the above query.
Employees is the left table because it is the first table in the above query.
The Departments table is the left table.
Departments is not the left table because it is not the first table in the above query.
Departments is not the left table because it is not the first table in the above query.
